about: Product Truth configuration. Sources, freshness limits, attention thresholds and owner decisions. Edit here, then `python3 truth/tools/truth.py run`. Values marked default are provisional until the owner decides (truth/DECISIONS.md).

sources.name: Business Ledger data
sources.feeds: clients, tiers, health, open client bugs, incidents, events, 2026 ledger stories
sources.refresh: Ledger update cycle (CLAUDE.md): re-read live, then `python3 tools/ledger.py check`; bugs and incidents come from the Planhat digest

sources.name: Ledger requests (promises)
sources.feeds: commitments to clients, due months, Jira status
sources.refresh: ArtifactData list `pipeline` on the ledger URL into live/db/pipeline (update cycle step 1)

sources.name: Story analysis
sources.feeds: every EP Story 2023 to now with customers, tier and value driver
sources.refresh: `python3 tools/stories.py plan` delta → enrich → `python3 tools/story_analysis.py prep / merge / check`

sources.name: 2026 story cache
sources.feeds: the 2026 stories with epic and what / why / outcome
sources.refresh: Story delta run (CLAUDE.md): metadata pull → `python3 tools/stories.py plan <file>` → merge → check

sources.name: Product-area tagging
sources.refresh: Classify new stories to data/stories/pa/SPEC.md v2, then `python3 tools/product_areas.py apply / check`

sources.name: Roadmap themes
sources.feeds: customer-facing theme and feature per finished story

sources.name: Requests database
sources.feeds: open Feature Requests, Open Stories and FIS intake pages, with comments and customers
sources.refresh: Re-pull `requests/raw` (requests/SPEC.md scope), then `python3 tools/requests.py build && python3 tools/requests.py check`

sources.name: Demand intelligence
sources.feeds: product, what / why / outcome, built overlap and demand cluster per request
sources.refresh: `python3 tools/intel.py prep` → enrichment agents → `merge` → `cprep` → clustering agents → `build` → `check` (intel/SPEC.md)

sources.name: Product knowledge base catalogue
sources.feeds: the 22 products, their domains and documented features
sources.refresh: Re-extract from the product knowledge base when it changes

live.jql: ((project = EP AND issuetype in (Bug, Story, "Feature Request")) OR project = IMP)

decisions.title: Is Informa (82918) a client?
decisions.why: It is a group parent (Planhat type Prospect), counted as a Tier 4 client today.
options: Label as group parent and leave it out of rankings
Keep it as a normal client

decisions.title: Which scoring weights rank the signals?
decisions.why: No priority score exists. Until you set weights the hub ranks clients by how many attention flags they raise, and demand by the tier signal (T1 8, T2 4, T3 2, T4 1).
options: Keep flag counts and tier signal (no invented total)

decisions.title: Are the attention thresholds right?
decisions.why: Show within 8 weeks, incident in 30 days, Urgent or High bugs, no delivery for 180 days, 10 or more open asks, Planhat health 4 or lower. Invented, never argued.
options: Change them (say which in the note)

decisions.title: How should older stories get a product?
decisions.why: Only the 1,196 stories from 2026 carry a knowledge-base product. Older ones are placed by their Jira component, or by roadmap theme, and marked lower confidence.
options: Run the SPEC v2 classification agents on 2023 to 2025

decisions.title: Where do the unresolved Informa entities belong?
decisions.why: Informa Smartevents, Healthcare, Qmed, Premiere, Asia and others raise 110+ requests, but the entity behind each is not evidenced.
options: Keep them as organisations outside the ledger
Map each to Informa North America or Informa Markets (UK) (say which in the note)

decisions.title: Promote the ledger redesign preview?
decisions.why: The preview has its own database and diverges from live every day it stays open.
options: Promote it to the live ledger
decisions.affects: Ledger only; the hub links to the live ledger

decisions.title: Which story set does the ledger report on?
decisions.why: The ledger shows 684 stories; this hub holds all 3,328 with stage as a field.
options: Ledger keeps 684; the hub holds all
Ledger moves to the full set
